name: Minniyo Chat
author: Team Minniyo

sections.description:
Minniyo Chat is a powerful WordPress plugin that seamlessly integrates your Minniyo AI-powered chatbot into your WordPress website. Enhance visitor engagement, provide instant customer support, and capture more leads with intelligent conversational AI.

Important Notice: Third-Party Service

This plugin connects to Minniyo’s external service to function. By using this plugin, you acknowledge that it sends data to and receives data from Minniyo’s servers. Please review the information below carefully before installation.

External Service Usage

This plugin relies on the Minniyo external service (https://app.minniyo.com) to provide chatbot functionality. The plugin communicates with Minniyo’s servers in the following ways:

What data is sent:
* Your Integration API Key (used to identify your chatbot configuration)
* Website visitor conversations with the chatbot
* Visitor information that may include: name, email, phone number, or other data voluntarily provided during chat interactions
* Website URL and referrer information
* Browser and device information (collected by the embedded chatbot script)

When data is sent:
* When the plugin verifies your API key configuration (during setup and testing)
* When a visitor interacts with the chatbot on your website
* Continuously while the chatbot is active on your website

Why data is sent:
* To load and display the customized chatbot widget on your website
* To process visitor conversations using Minniyo’s AI technology
* To capture and store leads in your Minniyo CRM
* To provide analytics and reporting on chatbot performance

Service Endpoints:
* Chatbot Embed Service: https://app.minniyo.com/chat/embed/
* Minniyo Application: https://app.minniyo.com

Legal Information:
* Service Provider: Minniyo
* Terms of Service: https://minniyo.com/terms-of-service
* Privacy Policy: https://minniyo.com/privacy-policy

By using this plugin, you agree to Minniyo’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. You are responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable data protection regulations (such as GDPR, CCPA) when using this service and for informing your website visitors about the data collection and processing through Minniyo’s service.

Note: A paid Minniyo subscription is required to use this plugin. Visit https://minniyo.com for more information about subscription plans.

Key Features

  • Easy Integration – Connect your Minniyo chatbot in just a few clicks with a simple API key
  • AI-Powered Conversations – Engage visitors with intelligent, natural conversations
  • Lead Management – Capture and manage leads directly from your chatbot
  • Real-time Support – Provide instant support to your website visitors 24/7
  • Simple Configuration – User-friendly admin interface with toggle on/off functionality
  • Connection Testing – Built-in connection test to verify your setup
  • Lightweight & Fast – Minimal impact on your website’s performance
  • Fully Responsive – Works perfectly on all devices and screen sizes

How It Works

  1. Sign up for a Minniyo account at Minniyo.com
  2. Create and customize your AI chatbot in the Minniyo dashboard
  3. Get your Integration API Key from the widget settings
  4. Install and activate this plugin on your WordPress site
  5. Enter your API key and enable the chatbot
  6. Your chatbot will appear on your website automatically!

Why Choose Minniyo Chat?

  • No Coding Required – Simple setup process for non-technical users
  • Hassle-Free Integration – Works with any WordPress theme
  • Secure & Reliable – Built following WordPress coding standards
  • Regular Updates – Continuous improvements and new features
  • Dedicated Support – Get help when you need it at support@minniyo.com

Perfect For

  • E-commerce websites
  • Business websites
  • Service providers
  • Bloggers and content creators
  • Support teams
  • Marketing and sales teams

Additional Resources

  • Official Website
  • Minniyo Dashboard
  • Documentation
  • Support

Privacy Policy

Third-Party Service Disclosure

Minniyo Chat plugin embeds the Minniyo chatbot widget on your WordPress website by connecting to Minniyo’s external service at https://app.minniyo.com. This is essential for the plugin’s functionality.

Data Handling:

Plugin-Stored Data:
* The plugin stores only your Integration API Key and chatbot enable/disable settings in your WordPress database
* No visitor conversation data or personal information is collected or stored by the plugin itself

Data Sent to Minniyo Service:
* All chat conversations between your website visitors and the chatbot are processed by Minniyo’s external service
* Visitor information (such as name, email, phone number) voluntarily provided during chat interactions is sent to Minniyo
* Website metadata (URL, referrer, timestamp) is transmitted for analytics purposes
* Browser and device information may be collected by the chatbot embed script

Data Processing and Storage:
* All conversation data is processed and stored on Minniyo’s servers according to their privacy policy
* Lead information is stored in your Minniyo CRM dashboard
* Conversation history and analytics are maintained by Minniyo’s service

Your Responsibilities:
* Inform your website visitors about the use of Minniyo’s chatbot service through your privacy policy
* Ensure compliance with applicable data protection regulations (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)
* Obtain necessary consent from visitors before collecting personal information through the chatbot
* Review and comply with Minniyo’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy

Minniyo’s Privacy Policy:
For detailed information about how Minniyo collects, uses, and protects user data, please review:
* Privacy Policy: https://minniyo.com/privacy-policy
* Terms of Service: https://minniyo.com/terms-of-service

Data Deletion:
To delete data collected through the chatbot, you must contact Minniyo support at support@minniyo.com or manage it through your Minniyo CRM dashboard. Uninstalling this plugin will remove settings from your WordPress database but will not delete data stored on Minniyo’s servers.

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports:
* Email: support@minniyo.com
* Website: https://minniyo.com

Credits

This plugin is developed and maintained by the Minniyo team.
sections.installation:
1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Minniyo Chat”
  4. Click Install Now button
  5. After installation, click Activate button
  6. Go to Minniyo Chat in your admin menu
  7. Enter your Integration API Key from Minniyo Dashboard
  8. Toggle Enable Chatbot to turn it on
  9. Click Save Settings
sections.faq:
What is Minniyo?

Minniyo is a premium AI-powered chatbot service that provides industry-specific intelligent chatbots tailored to your business needs. The chatbot captures leads from website visitors and integrates with Minniyo CRM for comprehensive lead management.

Do I need a Minniyo subscription to use this plugin?

Yes, you need an active Minniyo subscription to use this plugin. Minniyo is a paid service that provides customized AI chatbots according to your specific industry and business criteria. Visit Minniyo.com to explore subscription plans.

Is this plugin free?

Yes, this WordPress plugin is completely free to download and use. However, it requires a paid Minniyo subscription to function, as it connects to Minniyo’s AI chatbot service. Check Minniyo.com for pricing and subscription plans.

What features does Minniyo provide?

Minniyo provides:
* Industry-specific AI-powered chatbots customized to your business
* Automatic lead capture from website conversations
* Integrated CRM system for managing all captured leads
* Email management and sending capabilities from the CRM
* Real-time lead tracking and notifications
* Comprehensive analytics and reporting

How does lead management work?

When visitors interact with your chatbot, all captured leads are automatically sent to the Minniyo CRM. From your Minniyo dashboard, you can view, organize, and manage all leads, send follow-up emails, track conversations, and nurture prospects through your sales pipeline.

Where do I get my API key?

After subscribing to Minniyo, log in to your Minniyo Dashboard, navigate to the widget settings section, and copy your Integration API Key. Then paste it into the plugin settings in WordPress.

Can I customize the chatbot for my industry?

Yes! Minniyo creates AI chatbots tailored to your specific industry and business requirements. You can customize the chatbot’s behavior, responses, appearance, and lead capture criteria through your Minniyo Dashboard.

How do I access my leads?

All leads captured by your chatbot are automatically stored in the Minniyo CRM. Simply log in to your Minniyo Dashboard to view, manage, send emails to, and engage with your leads.

Can I send emails to leads from Minniyo?

Yes! The Minniyo CRM includes email management features, allowing you to send emails directly to your leads from within the platform.

The chatbot is not showing on my website. What should I do?

Please verify the following:
1. Ensure your Minniyo subscription is active
2. Check that the chatbot is enabled (toggle is ON) in the plugin settings
3. Verify your API key is entered correctly
4. Confirm your domain is added to the allowed domains in your Minniyo dashboard
5. Click the Test Connection button to verify your setup
6. Clear your browser cache and check again

Does it work with all WordPress themes?

Yes, Minniyo Chat is designed to work seamlessly with any WordPress theme that follows WordPress coding standards.

Will this affect my website speed?

No, the plugin is lightweight and loads the chatbot asynchronously, ensuring minimal impact on your website’s performance.

Can I use this on multiple websites?

Yes, you can install the plugin on multiple websites. Each website will need its own API key from your Minniyo dashboard, and your subscription plan should support multiple domains.

Where can I get support?

For technical support, questions about your subscription, or assistance with setup, contact Minniyo support at support@minniyo.com.
